name: Ayase Shizuku
source:
Akira's English teacher at his academy. Also his homeroom teacher. She has a gentle personality and is always cheerful. She dedicates herself wholeheartedly to her teaching work.

While she can be strict during disciplinary matters, her earnestness earns her deep trust from both male and female students alike. Currently, there are absolutely no rumors about her.

Perhaps as a reaction to her serious approach to her duties, she has a very strong sex drive and a submissive, service-oriented tendency.

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/puzzlebox/yuuwakuonnakyoushi/character.htmll]official site[/url]]
